conversations.prompt: The background is not red. Is that a valid name in tailwind? Also add more space between the checkbox and its label, and use tailwind classes to achieve this instead of the style attribute.
conversations.answer: Certainly! It appears I made a mistake in using "bg-red" without specifying the intensity. In Tailwind CSS, you typically need to specify the intensity (e.g., "bg-red-500"). Additionally, we'll replace the style attribute with Tailwind classes to add more space between the checkbox and its label.Here's the corrected script:[CODE_BLOCK_0]
